system: You transcribe pages of a hand-copied Chinese manuscript (the Siku quanshu copy of 本草綱目, 18th century) exactly as written.
task: Transcribe this half-leaf. It is written in vertical columns read from right to left. Return one entry per column, in reading order (rightmost column first). Rules: copy the characters as written, keeping traditional and variant forms (do not modernise or simplify); add no punctuation; where a column has small characters in two sub-columns, write the right sub-column first, then the left one, in the same entry; write □ for a character you cannot read; leave out the page-edge margin text (book title and leaf number in the fold).
